# Naser Ezzati-Jivan Publications

> Canonical, year-grouped research catalog with stable paper pages, technical summaries, citation guidance, and machine-readable records.

- Catalog: https://naser.github.io/research-publications/
- Catalog JSON: https://naser.github.io/research-publications/catalog.json
- Paper JSON Schema: https://naser.github.io/research-publications/schemas/paper.schema.json
- Crossref bibliography cache: https://naser.github.io/research-publications/schemas/crossref-bibliography.json
- Controlled topics: https://naser.github.io/research-publications/topics/index.html
- Recurring keywords: https://naser.github.io/research-publications/keywords/index.html
- Research profile: https://naser.github.io/tabs/research/
- ORCID: https://orcid.org/0000-0003-1435-6297
- Source repository: https://github.com/naser/research-publications

Each paper page exposes JSON, BibTeX, RIS, citation metadata, Schema.org ScholarlyArticle JSON-LD, a canonical citation target, and authoritative version links. Publisher PDFs are not redistributed.
